intro: Set your goal, choose who can remind you, and style one compact water overlay. Viewer reminders never change your total.

sections.title: 1. Goal and reminders
sections.description: Choose your daily water goal, serving size, and live-only reminder interval.
sections.notice: Water resets automatically at local midnight by default. The reminder timer pauses offline and restarts when water is logged.

sections.title: 2. Viewer reminders
sections.description: Twitch and Kick use rewards; YouTube and TikTok use !hydrate.
sections.notice: Viewer reminders never add water. Shared and per-viewer cooldowns keep requests from becoming spam.

sections.title: 3. Creator controls and announcements
sections.description: Log water with the broadcaster-only chat command, Stream Deck, or a creator hotkey.
sections.notice: Use !water 8, undo, snooze, reset, or status. Attach Log Water to a Stream Deck button or hotkey for one-tap logging. Speaker.bot is optional and is used only to speak reminders and confirmations.

sections.title: 4. Messages
sections.description: Customize reminder and confirmation text. Available tokens appear below each field.

sections.title: 5. Overlay appearance
sections.description: Choose the vessel, information, and colors shown on stream.
sections.notice: Use a 520 x 620 browser source for the compact card. Show the exact template before positioning or cropping it; do not stretch the source.
